command:
dotnet build LiteDB.sln -c Release
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/vector/Invoke-VectorUpgrade.ps1 -DatabasePath <legacy-db-path> -DryRun -SkipValidations -ReportPath artifacts_temp/vector-followup/upgrade-report.md
expectedOutcome: Release builds succeed for every target and the plugin-first upgrade orchestrator compiles MigrationHelpers, loads the upgrade manifest, and produces a dry-run report without surfacing vector references inside LiteDB/.
notes: Use a sanitized legacy database copy when invoking the upgrade script. Preserve the generated report under artifacts_temp/vector-followup so reviewers can confirm manifest execution, helper wiring, and plugin registration telemetry.
